about: One migrate unit, started by the writer's comment under the untagged ferry line: it copies the line to idea-tobias with an [AGENT] line the comment asks for. The batch check approves it and `pointers` writes its pointer. The real Edit guard raises agent-line-added on b1-u1. b1-u1 is approved and its trigger kind is `comment`, so the flag skips the flags call and the [AGENT] line stands: `act` at pointed writes no verify-flags.json and goes straight to acted, next_check null. `close` needs no second check. The handled list gets the ferry line as `migrated` with its pointer, the tagged copy as `written`, and the comment as `comment`. The log lists the line under Migrated and the [AGENT] line under Other edits you asked for, naming the trigger's comment.
spec: spec-run-manager.md 05 item 8; 04 item 22 (the `act` row at pointed); 07.3 item 2 entry 4; 11 item 101

readings: No verify-flags.json is written. The runner can't check a file's absence, so the open run's step is the check: `act` at pointed reaching `acted` means nothing went to the call.
flags-1.json is the real Edit guard's output on this case's state, taken by running the steps on 2026-10-23.

Log wording (plan-run-manager.md 06 item 14, reading 1): exactly one comment in the unit's piece holds the trigger's text, so the entry quotes that comment whole, %% marks included, with its note, as a judged flag's line does. Tightened 2026-10-23.
